decided.claim: Treat a BEL as a claim needing corroboration, not a finish: the handler routes it through a pure classify_bell(latched, pane_age, screen_working, cached_thinking, idle_for) -> Ring | Defer | Ignore, keeping the whole policy unit-testable without a PTY (same idiom as wants_human/looks_blocked).

'Demonstrably still working' = the offset-immune agent_is_thinking() live-screen read at bell time; when the working footer is on screen the bell is Deferred (bell_pending), never rung — false is the worst outcome, so ambiguity always defers.

Restore burst is killed by two layers: a 10s BELL_SPAWN_GRACE (spawned field) ignoring all bells while the resumed CLI replays its transcript, plus an evidence gate — with the screen idle, a bell only rings if this pane recently watched the agent work (cached thinking still set, or the working-to-idle flip observed within 5s); otherwise Ignore. The evidence gate also stops stray beeps from long-idle agents, and a latched bell ignores repeat BELs instead of re-notifying.

A deferred bell is resolved by the existing settled 120ms scan via pure resolve_pending_bell: ring once idle has held the same 300ms debounce the scan uses (skipping only the 1200ms real-spell test, since the BEL is the evidence that test approximates), keep holding while ambiguous, discard after 5s of demonstrable work (mid-turn beep - the eventual finish belongs to the scan path).

When pending is armed and the scan sees idle but no flip edge was ever recorded (footer came and went between settled ticks), seed not_thinking_since so the debounce can run; with think_since unset the scan's own ring stays inert, so scan-path behaviour is preserved (its inline 300ms literal swapped for the shared BELL_IDLE_DEBOUNCE constant, value unchanged).

Lifecycle hygiene: every ring site clears bell_pending plus the spell fields; ack_bell clears pending only past its existing early-return, so acknowledging an announced finish cannot be re-announced, while a mere glance at a still-working pane cannot lose a deferred one; pending is dropped if the pane leaves agent mode or the scan's ring wins the race.

Six table-tests in pane.rs's existing test module cover both reported bugs and the preserved fast path: defer-while-working, ignore-replayed-restore-bells, ring-at-bell-speed on idle+evidence, ignore idle stray beeps and double BELs, ring-only-after-idle-holds, and mid-turn-beep expiry.

least_confident.why: The 10s spawn grace and 5s recent-flip window are judgment constants, not measured: a very large transcript on a slow disk could conceivably replay past 10s (the evidence gate is the real backstop there), and 5s recent-flip is my guess at how late a genuine finish's BEL can trail the observed flip.

Skipping the real-spell test on the deferred path is a deliberate loosening: a mid-turn beep followed within 5s by a 300ms+ working-footer flicker would ring falsely - though the scan's own path already rings on such a flicker mid-turn (real spell holds), so I believe this adds no new risk class.

Seeding not_thinking_since from the pending path writes a field the scan's edge detector owns; I traced the interactions (edge on thinking-start resets it, think_since stays None so the scan ring stays inert) but this is the change most likely to have an interaction I missed.
